design_status: prespecified development pilot; not a protected final holdout
target: Own-bill public-law enactment before the constitutional end of its Congress
features: days since latest available version capped at 730 / 730
versions available in last 30 days capped at 10 / 10
training: Use earlier-Congress eligible snapshots only, remove all identified test-family overlap and retain lexicographically first training bill per family. Fit preprocessing on training rows. Minimum 20 families and both labels.
primary_metric: Paired Brier difference: candidate minus baseline; negative favors candidate
uncertainty: 2000 test-family cluster bootstrap replicates, seed 20261024; conditional on fitted model, not Congress-level or training-sample uncertainty
publication_audit: GovInfo MODS identity/dateIssued plus successful PREMIS Ingestion, ACP Creation and Parsing; availability is the latest of those first-event dates and MODS dateIngested, at end of day plus one day. No bill-status action date is used as publication proof. Current rendition bytes are not claimed identical to historical bytes.
feature_scope: Version existence and procedural stage only; no retrospective summaries, topics, current sponsor counts, modern embeddings, or outcome text in model features. Counts are published versions, not legislative action counts.
training_labels: Complete National Archives 114th public-law lists cross-checked against all 329 public-law entries in Statutes volumes 129 and 130. Label availability no earlier than the volumes' archived public-access dates. Negatives require this census.
test_labels: Complete National Archives 118th public-law lists (274 laws), cross-checked against each sampled bill's official BILLSTATUS public-law references. Test outcomes never enter fitting.
family_audit: Conservative union of official related-bill links and identical normalized introduced titles across sampled bills. Automated, not exhaustive manual provision lineage; residual family leakage remains a limitation.
no_adaptation: No replacing excluded bills, changing sample boundaries, tuning features/hyperparameters, or selecting another checkpoint after scores. A failed audit blocks scoring rather than silently reducing the sample.
interpretation: Low-numbered bills are not representative. One test Congress cannot establish generalization, calibration, causality or readiness for deployment. A negative result is retained. Statistical positive signal is provisional only.
